import { useMessage } from '@src/utils/useMessage';
import { EMPTY_STRING } from '@src/constants/common';
import App from '@src/response-apps/skillBook/detail/app';
import { selects } from '@src/response/config';
import { extractArgs, parseSkillBookIndex } from '@src/utils/commandParser';
import { FormatGui } from '@src/utils/messageHelper';
import { buildFailureMessage, formatSkillBookDetail } from '@src/utils/skillBookHelper';
import { Format, onResponse } from 'alemonjs';

const response = onResponse(selects, async e => {
  const [message] = useMessage();
  const bid = e?.UserId;
  const isPrivate = e.isPrivate ?? false;

  try {
    // uid 已由中间件验证并设置
    const uid = e.uid as number;

    // 解析命令参数
    const args = extractArgs(e.MessageText || EMPTY_STRING, /^(!|！|\/|#|＃)?查看功法\s*/);
    const parseResult = parseSkillBookIndex(args);

    if (!parseResult.success) {
      const md = Format.createMarkdown();

      md.addText(
        buildFailureMessage(
          '参数错误',
          `${parseResult.errorMessage}\n\n` +
            '使用方法:\n' +
            '/查看功法 [功法ID]\n\n' +
            '示例:\n' +
            '/查看功法 123   ← 查看ID为123的功法详情\n\n' +
            '💡功法ID为【我的功法】中功法前面的数字'
        )
      );

      void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '', content: md }));

      return;
    }

    const skillBookId = parseResult.value!;

    const result = await App({ bid, uid, skillBookId });

    if (result.code === 'OK') {
      const md = formatSkillBookDetail(result.data.skillBook, result.data.skillBookId, result.data.proficiencyPoints);
      const view = result.data.skillBook.detailDisplay!;
      const visibilityCommands = { SHOW: '/显示功法', HIDE: '/隐藏功法' } as const;
      const footer = [
        { label: '返回', command: '/我的功法' },
        { label: '升级', command: `/升级功法 ${result.data.skillBookId}` },
        { label: '换词', command: `/换词 ${result.data.skillBookId}` },
        ...(view.visibilityAction !== 'NONE'
          ? [
              {
                label: view.visibilityLabel!,
                command: `${visibilityCommands[view.visibilityAction]} ${result.data.skillBookId}`
              }
            ]
          : []),
        ...(view.canReset ? [{ label: '重制', command: `/重制功法 ${result.data.skillBookId}` }] : [])
      ];

      void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '', content: md, footer }));
    } else if (result.code === 'NO_SKILL_BOOKS') {
      const md = Format.createMarkdown();

      md.addText(buildFailureMessage('暂无已学习的功法', '💡可通过 /学习功法 学习功法秘籍'));

      void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '', content: md }));
    } else if (result.code === 'NOT_FOUND') {
      const md = Format.createMarkdown();

      md.addText(buildFailureMessage('功法ID错误', `找不到ID为 ${result.data.skillBookId} 的已学功法\n\n💡请使用 /我的功法 查看功法ID`));

      void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '', content: md }));
    } else {
      const md = Format.createMarkdown();

      md.addText(result.data.message);

      void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '', content: md }));
    }
  } catch {
    const md = Format.createMarkdown();

    md.addText('查看功法详情失败，请稍后再试或联系运营。');

    void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '', content: md }));
  }
});

export default response;
